warnings: Steel hip roof (ปั้นหยา) over an L/T plan. Members from the sheet's หมายเหตุ legend: dashed = แป เหล็กกล่อง 25x25x1.6 @0.50 (or galvanised purlin), solid = จันทัน C-100x50x20x3.2 @1.00, dash-dot-dot double line = ตะเข้ราง C-100x50x20x3.2, dash-dot = ตะเข้สัน 2C-100x50x20x3.2, long dash-short dash = อกไก่ 2C-150x50x20x3.2. The wall plates (อะเส), king posts and RB1 below this frame are on S-03 (separate file).

No member on this sheet carries a mark, so every entry is element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2), grouped per member type. Hips and valleys are diagonal (spans unresolved per section 4); ridge ends at the hip junctions do not sit on printed ticks, so the ridge is recorded as covering ranges, not atomic spans. Hip/valley counts are counted from the drawn lines (flagged); rafter and purlin counts are not recorded.
'เหล็กกล่อง 25x25x1.6' is recorded with designation SHS (square box section); the print is kept verbatim in printed_as.
